description: This file defines a Python module for plotting external data within the BORIS behavioral observation software. It includes classes for data visualization using matplotlib and PySide6, handles data loading, processing, and real-time plotting, and contains a main script for running as a standalone application with command-line arguments.

classes.name: MyMplCanvas
classes.description: A custom matplotlib canvas for plotting within PySide6 widgets.

classes.name: Plot_data
classes.description: Main widget class for loading, processing, and plotting external data with interactive controls.

classes.name: Plotter
classes.description: Helper class responsible for generating plot data slices for real-time visualization.

methods.name: MyMplCanvas.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the matplotlib figure and axes, sets size policy.

methods.name: Plot_data.__init__
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the plotting widget, loads data, and initializes threading and signals.

methods.name: Plot_data.eventFilter
methods.description: Handles keypress events to send to main window.

methods.name: Plot_data.zoom
methods.description: Adjusts the zoom level of the plot.

methods.name: Plot_data.timer_plot_data_out
methods.description: Triggers plot update based on timer.

methods.name: Plot_data.update_plot
methods.description: Emits signal to update plot with current time offset.

methods.name: Plot_data.close_plot
methods.description: Stops thread and closes the widget.

methods.name: Plot_data.plot
methods.description: Receives data slices and renders the plot.

methods.name: Plotter.replot
methods.description: Generates data slices for plotting based on current time.
